findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 30 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 20 questions numbered 1-20; by section: u-introduction 1, 30.1 1, 30.2 1, 30.3 2, 30.4.1 2, 30.4.2 3, 30.4.3 1, 30.5 2, 30.6 3, 30.7 1, 30.7.1 1, 30.7.2 1, 30.7.3 1.

Theory parts cover the principle of ¹H NMR, nuclear spin of ¹H/¹²C/¹³C, deuterated solvents, chemical shift and TMS, chemical environment and electron density, Table 30.1, low-resolution spectra, n+1 splitting and its exceptions, D₂O exchange, predicting ¹H spectra, deducing structures, ¹³C NMR, carbon environments and Table 30.3, ¹H vs ¹³C, structure from ¹³C. Numericals (peak-area ratios, n+1 sub-peak counts, structure deduction) use new compounds and values, recomputed in Python. Book corrections followed (paired spins in even-even nuclei, peaks = environments, OCH₂ quartet, Figure 30.8 fits 2-methylpropan-1-ol).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
